jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Build with us

**Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

**Your impact

**This is your chance to build Mollie's presence in Denmark from the ground up, as the first person hired with this market as your sole focus. You won't be starting from zero: you'll have the Nordic foundation already built in Sweden to work from, but the Danish playbook is yours to write.

You'll open the market, land our first Danish customers, and turn early learnings into a repeatable approach we can scale. It's a broader, more entrepreneurial scope than a standard sales role. You'll work deals from $100K a month while building toward bigger opportunities of up to $1 million a month, all while shaping how Mollie understands and enters this market for the long run.

What makes this role stand out is the mix: outbound selling, customer discovery, partnerships, and competitive analysis, all rolled into one seat with real ownership. If you want to build something rather than maintain something, this is that opportunity.

**What You'll Ship

**

• Run outbound sales and manage the full sales process, including around 20 cold calls a week

• Build a Danish pipeline and land Mollie's first customers in the market

• Gather market feedback and grow larger opportunities, including deals of up to $1 million a month

• Build relationships with Danish agencies and work on partnerships alongside the partner manager based in Stockholm

• Share what you learn about the Danish marketing landscape with the marketing team to help shape events and go-to-market plans

• Run competitive analysis to sharpen how Mollie positions itself in Denmark

**What You'll Bring

**

• Around 5 years of full-cycle sales experience, with a strong outbound track record and demonstrated success in structured cold outreach

• Value selling capability, with a data-driven approach to activity and pipeline management

• Strong negotiation and contract handling skills, including experience communicating and negotiating with C-level stakeholders

• Creativity in building a pipeline through partnerships or marketing outreach (you don't need to have done this before, just show the potential)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or SaaS sales, built across multiple companies

• Comfortable working hands-on in a role with broad scope and real uncertainty

• Fluency in Danish

**Grow your way

**At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

**AI at Mollie

**We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

WS Audiology, driven by a passion for improving lives, is a leading force in the hearing aid industry. Our goal is to enhance our presence in an underserved market and accelerate business transformation to reach more people effectively.

Reporting to the VP Enterprise Lean of our company, we are seeking an experienced and dynamic Lead of Lean Leadership and Fundamentals to spearhead the implementation and integration of Lean principles across our organization. This role is critical in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of Lean methodologies and have a proven track record in training and mentoring teams to achieve transformative results, across different business functions.

What you will do

• Lean fundamentals deployment: Creating and implementing a strategy for deploying fundamental Lean tools across the enterprise. Collaborating with senior leadership to align lean initiatives with business goals and involves monitoring their effectiveness, adjusting based on feedback and metrics.

• Lean leadership and culture training: Designing training programs centered on lean leadership principles and facilitating workshops to foster a culture of lean thinking. Mentoring leaders to model lean behaviors within their teams.

• Lean onboarding: Establishing a structured lean onboarding program for new employees, ensuring they grasp the importance of lean methodologies in their roles.

• Lean skills development and funnel management: Identifying skill gaps within enterprise and creating targeted training solutions to enhance lean capabilities. Implementing a funnel management system for tracking capability building and collaborating with departments for cohesive skill development.

• Continuous Improvement Advocacy: Promotes a culture of continuous improvement by advocating for lean tools and techniques. Assessments of Lean maturity to provide actionable insights and facilitate the sharing of best practices across organization.

What you bring

Experience

• 7+ years experience in a lean role, with a focus on broad application of lean fundamentals as well as lean leadership development.

• Proven experience in designing and delivering training programs related to lean fundamentals and lean leadership.

• Strong understanding of fundamental lean tools such as A3 Problem Solving, Visual Daily Management, Value Stream Mapping, Transactional/business Process Improvement, 5S and Kaizen Events.

• Proven experience in applying fundamental lean tools to improve process performance and generate real impact in multiple business areas (not only manufacturing).

• Experience with kaizen funnel management and lean capabilities (certification) funnel management.

Personal competencies

• Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, numerical skills, and attention to detail for effective problem-solving

• Strategic mindset that can adapt quickly to tactical needs; forward-thinking and collaborative.

• Proven track record of managing multiple projects and meeting critical deadlines

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and a commitment to building relationships internally and externally

• Effective communicator across all organizational levels, from blue collars to executive offices, with strong leadership and organizational abilities.

Who we are

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is looking for a Regulatory CMC Writer to support global marketing applications across our growing portfolio.

In this role, you will author and participate in the review of high-quality CMC documentation, with a primary focus on global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), and New Drug Applications (NDAs). Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will translate complex manufacturing, analytical, and formulation development information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management activities. Your contribution will help ensure that CMC documentation presents a coherent scientific rationale and is delivered within agreed submission timelines. You will also contribute to improving writing quality and efficiency through the thoughtful use of AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your primary focus will be CMC documentation supporting global BLA/MAA/NDA filings and responses to health authority questions during assessment.

**Your Responsibilities Include

**

• Authoring and reviewing Module 3 CTD sections, covering manufacturing processes, process controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facility

• Translating technical reports and source data into clear, scientifically sound regulatory narratives in close collaboration with subject matter experts

• Coordinating document preparation and review with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners, including contract manufacturing organizations

• Consolidating review comments, facilitating their resolution, and ensuring that documents are completed and approved within agreed timelines

• Verifying the accuracy of data presented in CMC documents against source documentation and ensuring consistency across related sections and submissions

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and implementing the resulting updates to CMC submission documents

• Maintaining source document trackers and ensuring traceability of supporting information and regulatory document updates

• Supporting lifecycle maintenance of CMC documentation, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed

• Applying AI and digital tools to improve writing quality, consistency, and efficiency, while critically evaluating outputs and ensuring scientific accuracy and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Following and contributing to the continuous improvement of CMC writing and response principles, templates, internal procedures, and style guides

• Performing CMC writing activities in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable procedures

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or related technical discipline. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

You bring at least four years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience authoring and reviewing CMC regulatory sections or supporting source documents, with the ability to take ownership of defined sections with limited supervision

• Experience participating in global regulatory submissions and/or a strong background in pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing processes. Direct experience supporting BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is a strong advantage

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements across development stages and familiarity with CTD structure

• Knowledge of GxP, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements relevant to CMC activities

• Excellent written English and the ability to distil complex scientific information into clear, concise, and well-structured text

• Strong attention to detail, with the ability to verify data, identify inconsistencies, and maintain scientific accuracy across documents

• Practical experience using AI tools to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including the ability to formulate effective prompts, critically assess outputs, and verify scientific content

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional reviews and facilitate alignment without direct authority

• A proactive and structured approach to planning, prioritizing, and delivering quality work within demanding submission timelines

• A demonstrated track record of effective collaboration and reliable delivery in previous roles, together with curiosity, openness to feedback, and an interest in improving ways of working

Application deadline: 1. November 2026

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK582.400,00---873.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. PIM is central to our architecture, syndicating product data to ecommerce, marketplaces, retail, and marketing systems, so you'll work at the intersection of data architecture, content quality, and discoverability.

As our new Product Manager, you'll own the product strategy and delivery for our PIM platform, with InRiver preferred as our PIM technology. You'll work closely with data, engineering, and content teams to define the data model, govern data quality, and ensure product information flows correctly to every downstream channel.

This role is critical to how our products are found and understood—not just by customers on our own site, but increasingly by AI-driven answer engines and generative search. You'll balance strategic roadmap planning with hands-on technical execution, vendor management, and continuous improvement of our data model.

Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for our PIM platform, ensuring the data model and architecture support both business and technical needs

• Design and optimize data flows between PIM and downstream systems (ecommerce, marketplaces, DAM, ERP), working closely with engineering

• Partner with content, SEO, and marketing teams to structure and enrich product information for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

• Manage vendor relationships, including roadmap alignment, issue escalation, and feature adoption

• Monitor data quality, syndication performance, and platform health, identifying optimization opportunities and driving continuous improvement

• Stay ahead of trends in PIM, product data architecture, and AI-driven discovery, bringing forward strategic recommendations

We would love if you could bring:

• 5+ years of experience in product management, data platforms, or PIM—ideally within ecommerce or product content operations

• Technical understanding of PIM architecture, data modeling, and system integrations (APIs, ETL, syndication)

• Experience with InRiver or similar PIM platforms preferred

• Experience optimizing product information for AEO and GEO—structured data, schema markup, and content formats that AI systems and search engines can parse

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

• Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, consent management) is a plus

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology site in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s ambitions. Besides our inspiring workplace design, we’re proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This reflects our commitment to using natural resources responsibly and creating a space that is professional, dynamic, comfortable, and uniquely Pandora. The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Are you a highly motivated, accurate, and detail-oriented person with a passion for numbers? Are you eager to learn and grow in the accounting field? If so - we have an amazing opportunity for you!

We are looking for a junior accountant to join our growing Accounting team. As a junior accountant, you will be responsible for booking supplier invoices and handling finance-related emails.

We value teamwork and believe in the strength of collaboration. You will work closely with a group of committed young professionals who are passionate about what they do, eager to improve processes, and happy to help each other when needed. You will have the chance to learn and develop your skills in a supportive and collaborative environment. We have a great team spirit that is also shown across the Boozt organization.

If you want to work and grow within accounting and enjoy working in a fast-paced changing environment, then you may be the person we are looking for.

**What You Will Do

**

• Bookkeeping and processing of supplier invoices related to inventory purchases

• Daily follow-up of deliveries against purchase orders and inventory systems

• Assist with daily administrative tasks such as handling finance-related emails

• Communication with suppliers regarding delivery status, discrepancies, and invoice matters

• Collaboration with procurement, warehouse, and logistics teams to resolve delivery and invoice-related issues

• Responsibility for identifying inefficiencies in current processes and proposing improvements

**YOUR PROFILE

**To be successful in this role, you have attention to high-quality detail and accuracy. You are eager to learn and grow in the accounting field. Your approach to problem-solving is proactive and innovative. You are a positive, responsible, and structured person who thrives on collaboration. You can work in a fast-paced environment.

• Bachelor's degree or a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, along with work experience, is considered an advantage.

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

• Fluent in English - Boozt corporate language

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

**A LITTLE BIT ABOUT US

**We are one of the leading e-commerce players in the Nordics. We offer our customers fashion, kids, sports, beauty, and home on Boozt.com and Booztlet.com. Headquartered in Copenhagen, with over 1,100 colleagues across Europe, tech hubs in Vilnius and Poznań, and a fully automated warehouse in Ängelholm, we create value for both consumers and brands while fostering diversity, inclusion, and innovation.

FPRT is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

About FPRT

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building a new advanced defence manufacturing facility in Denmark. As we grow towards 300+ employees, we are looking for a hands-on Payroll & HR Operations Specialist to establish reliable people processes and support our transition to a multi-shift production environment.

Reporting to the CHRO, you will work closely with Finance, managers and external payroll and benefits providers. This is an opportunity to shape HR operations from an early stage, not simply maintain existing processes.

What you’ll do

• Coordinate the monthly Danish payroll process, checking salaries, shifts, overtime, allowances and payroll data with our external provider.

• Own accurate time and attendance administration in WorkLinq, working with managers to resolve discrepancies.

• Manage essential HR administration, including contracts, employee changes, pension and benefits coordination, and offboarding.

• Keep employee records and HR systems accurate, organised and compliant with Danish requirements and collective agreements.

• Improve everyday HR processes and reporting as the workforce grows, supporting a potential future transition to in-house payroll.

What we’re looking for

• 3-5+ years of hands-on experience with Danish payroll and HR administration; manufacturing or shift-based experience is an advantage.

• Working knowledge of Danish employment, tax, pension and payroll practices, including collective agreements.

• Confidence using payroll, HR and time-registration systems; experience with WorkLinq or similar tools is welcome.

• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy and a practical, service-minded approach.

• Strong language skills in Danish and English, oral and written

Why join FPRT?

• Build scalable payroll and HR operations for a new high-tech manufacturing site.

• Have direct impact on the employee experience and how a growing company operates.

• Work with an international team on a project supporting European security and defence.

• Competitive compensation and a new facility in Vojens.

Interested? We would be pleased to hear from candidates who enjoy combining accurate execution with building better ways of working.

Practical Information

• Full-time position with an immediate start.

• Location: Vojens, Denmark.

• Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
